The '''EE-2 blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Cartel Market" /> The [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] [[Ri'kan Kateen]] used an EE-2 blaster pistol during the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR:SoR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>
